name: feature.campaign-orchestration.agents
description: Campaign Studio agent pack — the Campaign Strategist, the chat-driven orchestrator. It reads campaign readiness (openwop:campaign-orchestration.status) and runs the full campaign conversationally by igniting the orchestration workflow (openwop:campaign-orchestration.run): validate → generate + approve the messaging kernel → generate each enabled channel (each approved inline) → cross-asset consistency check → finalize the marketing campaign, with every approval rendered as an inline HITL gate card.
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Campaign Strategist
